curation: Static code dataflow only; criterion/private selected-request section omitted.

findings.facts: At handler entry before session resolution or prepare, INFO inbound message copies event.text[:80] and reply_to_text[:80], newline-normalized and repr-formatted. This is a direct original-caption copy into diagnostics; truncation does not redact secrets. Replied-to content is a separate textual exposure at the same producer.

conversation turn INFO receives summarize_user_message_for_log(user_message)[:80] plus optional ellipsis. Summarizer returns scalar text or joins list text parts; images become count marker. It does no secret filtering. Thus the prepared user/model content, including any retained caption, reaches a second diagnostic logger.

Inbound preparation yields message_text plus persist_user_message; timestamp handling retains clean original user content separately from render metadata. The run path forwards message and persist override plus display metadata; stage builds role=user content from user_message and preserves display metadata. History/model input and logger output are distinct flows. A logging-only fix must leave event.text, message_text, persist_user_message, history, staged user row and its metadata unchanged.

message_type is available at gateway but not a build_turn_context argument. Attachment presentations are conditional on ordinary_file_scope and current metadata; presentation availability does not classify every secret-bearing user turn. A same-upload plain sendMessage continuation may carry a secret without attachment. No attachment classifier or metadata API is needed for unconditional safe producer logging.

The existing _preview_text is also used by the starting-conversation user-facing print when quiet_mode is false. Gateway fresh agents set quiet_mode=True, suppressing that print. Changing only logger args can leave this variable/print behavior unchanged. This source review is not a blanket claim that all non-gateway stdout paths are metadata-only.

limitations: Actual carrier bodies and credential values were not read. Runtime reachability and prior observations are supplied by parent, not independently replayed.

minimal_fix.agent: Log fixed input kind (e.g. str/list/none/other), content-part count and textual character count from already-supported input shapes. Do not stringify arbitrary content or log part payloads. Keep summarize helper and _preview_text for existing non-logger consumers unless the exact candidate deliberately narrows further.
minimal_fix.coverage: Apply at both producers unconditionally for str, multimodal and plain continuation, independent of attachment metadata availability.
minimal_fix.excluded_changes: No model/history/persistence argument mutation; no new signature/metadata/classifier/API; no global structured-tool projector or summarizer change.
minimal_fix.gateway: Replace both text preview logger operands/fields with fixed metadata: input kind, attachment count when directly available, inbound text character count, reply-to character count/presence; retain existing useful correlation metadata. Never log content, repr of event, names/paths from attachments, or secret hashes.

mode: readonly installed207 source review; no runtime/candidate acceptance
recommended_checks: Capture both INFO producers with synthetic distinctive sentinels in inbound text, reply-to text, plain continuation, and multimodal text; assert no full sentinel, prefix or text payload appears and assert intended counts/kind.
Cover empty/None values and non-text multimodal parts without stringify/repr fallback; malformed unsupported shapes should produce fixed metadata rather than content.
Compare staged user/model/history/persist payload identity/content before and after logger execution; ordinary original input must remain intact.
Parse/import only affected source scope, plus exact-diff review; no live models/Telegram/closed effect replay is needed for producer regression tests.
Treat source/logging regression success as source evidence only. Installed version/restart and future user behavior require separate Root integration facts.
verdict: CONFIRMED: two direct raw inbound diagnostic producers; unconditional metadata-only logging is the minimal compatible fix for attachment and plain continuation paths.
